exposure: Uncomplicated vaginal delivery vs. complicated delivery
cohort: 173 nulliparous women in their first trimester of pregnancy
finding: Loss of vaginal angulation occurs between trimesters and persists postpartum, while MMP-9 activity increases postpartum, with higher levels associated with uncomplicated vaginal delivery and greater recovery of vaginal angle.
mod_finding: Women experiencing uncomplicated vaginal delivery demonstrate higher postpartum MMP-9 activity and are more likely to have recovered their vaginal angle.
